summary: Gain in percent of the input becomes dB (100% is 0 dB, 200% +6.0 dB, 0% −inf); Mute becomes −inf.

rules.why: Pedal Gain multiplies by Gain ÷ 100, and by 0 while Mute is on (its source); Neo Utility's Gain is in dB, 0.1 dB steps.

unmapped.why: Mute's fade time; Neo Utility smooths every gain change itself (about 20 ms), with no setting. A Mute moved in a pattern fades in 20 ms, not in Inertia.

evidence: ExternalMachines/source/thepedal/pedal-gain/PedalGainMachine.cs: output = input × Gain/100, 0 while Mute is on
Machines/NeoUtility/Params.def: Gain −60.1 … +24 dB in 0.1 dB steps, −inf at its bottom
